implementation.scope: Chat only, shared runtimeFetch and all model-control functions unchanged
implementation.mechanism: Race complete transport/body-read promise against deadline; reject honest timeout first, then abort browser fetch. finally clears timer for success, ordinary failure, validation failure or timeout. Each request gets a new controller. Existing UserChat finally releases pending; catch retains question/session.
implementation.message: Batas waktu 30 detik tercapai. Backend mungkin masih memproses permintaan ini; pembatalan di browser tidak menjamin pembatalan di server. Coba lagi hanya secara manual.
implementation.retry: Manual only; no replay, memory deletion or backend/provider cancellation claim.
implementation.browser_cancellation_limit: AbortController only attempts browser transport cancellation. Backend may continue processing and recording memory; a manual retry can create another server request. No server cancellation/undo guarantee.

coverage: Never-resolving fetch with and without abort cooperation: pending at29999ms, honest timeout and released UI at30000ms
Question retained, New Chat/send enabled, no automatic replay after another60000ms
Manual retry retains original question and session and uses new nonaborted controller
Only chat/model-status requests; no memory deletion request
Success/HTTP503/network error/invalid public response clear all timers; no delayed abort
Model status/inventory/selection have no deadline signal/timer even after60000ms
All ten pre-existing assistant cases still pass: New Chat, same-session followup, multiline, public response, unavailable/private-field error and model control
actual_tests.provider_and_storage: Mocked fetch/fixture UI responses; no real provider generation or server conversation memory writes

exact_diff.baseline: Captured byte-for-byte pre-task files; target files pre-existed within untracked control-plane directory. No comparison/revert to Git HEAD used.
exact_diff.changed_symbols: sendUserChat only in API; assistant test imports/cleanup and new timeout/model isolation cases. Existing ten tests retained.

preservation.limitations: Scoped hashes cover source, tests, existing docs/reports/cache/config/service/bundle; new evidence excluded. Five pre-existing unreadable test-temp directories retained as limits. Live database/environment secret values not inspected. No full-filesystem immutability claim.

rollback.precondition: Verify current target hashes still equal after_sha256; if later user edits exist, stop for hunk review. Never copy complete before files over current files or reset/checkout/discard.
rollback.effect: Reverse only this task diff; preserve all pre-existing file contents/user changes. Rehash against before_sha256 afterwards. This is local hunk rollback, not runtime rollback; do not stop or replace PID33160.
